title: Chapter 6025: Poye’S Shell

Chapter 6025: Poye’S Shell

Chapter 6025: Poye’s Shell

What one felt was neither evil nor darkness from this power but rather, a divine punishment or an ominous omen. It seemed to be carrying the will of the high heaven, forcing everyone down to their knees regardless of their cultivation.

Weaker emperors and desolate gods’ knees buckled, akin to beasts meeting their mortal foes.

“Where is it coming from?” Omni gazed at the depths of the main palace. Allmountain did the same with his heavenly gaze.

They roared the world but had never seen anything like this before.

“Boom!” A solar light from underground also erupted to stop the unknown darkness. It blinded spectators, forcing them to cover their eyes.

Within this radiance was a peerless woman attempting to stop the spread of darkness. When people opened their eyes, they were immediately drawn in by her peerless appearance and aura.

However, they noticed something rather hilarious - she was wearing a broken egg on her head.

Despite the comical appearance, it granted her enough strength to stop the ominous power.

“Unrivalled Monarch!” Many recognized her. [1]

“!” The attackers became emotional upon seeing the direct disciple of Splendor Monarch.

Her absence was the reason for the attack since they didn’t dare to confront her directly. Now, it became an issue of facing her vengeance in the future since she was still alive.

“Ancestor Poye’s shell…” Allmountain who activated his heavenly gaze noticed the egg and gasped.

“What did you say?!” Omni was shocked to hear the earth-shattering news. This confirmed Poye’s death because early on, his shell was rumored to have fallen.

Everyone tried to look for it including the three great dynasties. No one found it but most believed it had fallen into the possession of Immortal Suppression Dynasty.

Without seeing this shell, they didn’t believe in his death. After all, Poye was just too strong. Not even Desolate Ancestor, Lord of Life and Death, and Lord of Calamities working together could kill him.

The strongest members of Three Immortals have fought him, but none found true success. Alas, his death was all but assured now.

Who did it? No one was there to see the fight. Those from Life and Death Heaven or Supreme Heaven didn’t have more information regarding his death either.

Allmountain became frozen. As an emperor at the origination stage, he had a better perspective on Poye’s power. Poye was absolutely the strongest, certainly undefeatable. Killing him was virtually impossible. He couldn’t possibly fathom the level of existence capable of doing so.

As for Li Qiye, his gaze pierced through the depths of the main palace where he saw the thing Unrivalled Monarch was fighting against.

“I’ll be back.” He said before taking the statue from Sky Step King and throwing it into the main hall.

The eye opened again and released mercury-like rays. They seeped into the old palaces and removed the power of oblivion.

The entire region recovered swiftly - Greatsword’s group who was lost in this domain was dragged out and spared from the aging process.

1. How unfortunate, I hope I didn’t use he/him for the monarch in previous chapters. ☜
